offering_description.value: Autodesk sells software for designing buildings and infrastructure, managing construction, engineering and manufacturing products, and creating digital media. It develops desktop and cloud tools for architecture and engineering firms, contractors, manufacturers, media studios, independent creators, and public agencies.

primary_products.value: building information modeling software; computer-aided drafting and design software; construction management software; product engineering and manufacturing software; 3D animation and visual effects software

primary_services.value: software implementation consulting; workflow integration consulting; professional training

customer_segment.value: B2B: architecture and engineering firms, contractors, manufacturers, and film, television, and game studios; B2C: individual designers and digital artists who buy their own software; B2G: public works, transportation, and other government agencies that design or manage facilities and infrastructure

end_markets.value: architecture and engineering; building construction; civil infrastructure; industrial manufacturing; film, television, and video games

revenue_model.value: subscription: term-based access to individual software applications, bundled toolsets, and cloud platforms; transaction or usage fees: prepaid tokens redeemed for metered access to eligible software; service fees: implementation consulting and professional training
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops applications that turn drawings, models, and project data into shared workflows for design firms, builders, manufacturers, and studios; service provider: helps enterprise customers integrate Autodesk tools into existing workflows and train their teams

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: building and infrastructure design, construction management, product engineering and manufacturing, and digital content creation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Autodesk sales teams serving enterprise and public-sector accounts; online: Autodesk's web store for software subscriptions and prepaid usage tokens; partners / resellers: authorized software resellers and solution providers that advise customers on purchasing and deployment

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cloud services handle personal data subject to the EU General Data Protection Regulation and other privacy laws
